name: Surrakar
description: A sickly green, tailed, scaly creature in the caves beneath the Riverroot Tree, which attacks Obuun and is killed when he kicks it into a waterfall.

timeline.summary: Obuun stalks a surrakar into its caves and is nearly killed in the fight.
timeline.quote: Steel clashed against steel, throwing up sparks that lit the dim tunnel.

timeline.summary: In a vision of his mother and a fight, Obuun finds her short sword and fends off the surrakar.
timeline.quote: Obuun brought his mother's short sword up just in time to stop the surrakar from lopping his head off.

timeline.summary: Obuun's power over earth awakens, raising a stone slab and cracking a root; he stops before uprooting the tree.
timeline.quote: a slab of stone was rising up beneath his feet, responding to his need

timeline.summary: The surrakar bites Obuun's shoulder and he drives the sword in deeper before falling unconscious.
timeline.quote: The surrakar worried at his shoulder

timeline.summary: Obuun climbs a waterfall to escape and patiently retrieves his mother's sword, kicking the surrakar to its death.
timeline.quote: He kicked the creature as hard as he could.

relations.note: The surrakar are blamed for taking Obuun's parents.
relations.quote: The surrakar took my parents from me

pages_say.description: A sickly green, tailed, scaly creature in the caves beneath the Riverroot Tree, which attacks Obuun and is killed when he kicks it into a waterfall.
